notes.title: New "The Pirate" game !!!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Captains![/b][/h1]

It is with great pleasure that we present to you The Pirate: Plague of the Dead. You can already install this new installment in The Pirate series. 

The game features a fully open world with dynamic day and night cycle, and undead captains with unique skills, including the much-requested summoning of the mighty kraken. We didn’t forget about unique ship designs, which fit the dark mood of the game perfectly. These are just several new features of Plague of the Dead.

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/723790/The_Pirate_Plague_of_the_Dead/] Install The Pirate: Plague of the Dead[/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26004345/c01cc89fbf24267384b21a4090e8ea40f3448321.png[/img]
